import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv', 
                           columns=['Person ID', 'Gender', 'Age', 'Occupation', 
                                    'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                                    'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                                    'BMI Category', 'Blood Pressure', 
                                    'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Sleep Disorder'])

# Convert categorical variables
sleep_health['Gender'] = pd.Categorical(sleep_health['Gender'])
sleep_health['Occupation'] = pd.Categorical(sleep_health['Occupation'])
sleep_health['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(sleep_health['BMI Category'])
sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'] = pd.Categorical(sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'])
sleep_health['Blood Pressure'] = pd.Categorical(sleep_health['Blood Pressure'])

# Create a bar chart of average sleep duration by gender
gender_sleep_avg = sleep_health.groupby('Gender')['Sleep Duration'].mean().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', data=gender_sleep_avg)
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_gender_sleep.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a boxplot of sleep quality by occupation
occupation_sleep_quality = sleep_health.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].median().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.boxplot(x='Occupation', y='Quality of Sleep', data=occupation_sleep_quality)
plt.title('Median Sleep Quality by Occupation')
plt.xlabel('Occupation')
plt.ylabel('Median Sleep Quality')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_occupation_sleep.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of heart rate vs daily steps
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Daily Steps', y='Heart Rate', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps')
plt.xlabel('Daily Steps')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_heart_rate_steps.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
